reader_summary.overview: In this hallway-style conversation. How does all this, taken together, affect the way we work? And what can -- or can't -- policymakers do about it? Perhaps, Levinson argues. But that's a bitter pill to swallow for those seeking solace in easy answers from governments, whether at a national or city level.
